test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

The matter was discussed **privately without any intruders.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Behind closed doors**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Behind closed doors"** means something that is done privately without any public knowledge or presence. (बंद दरवाजों के पीछे)

 
 
• **Example: **The negotiations were held behind closed doors to ensure confidentiality.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Behind closed doors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Run out of steam** (हिम्मत हारना): To lose energy or enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** After the initial excitement, the team ran out of steam.
 
 
 
• **On the fence** (दुविधा में होना): To be undecided or not committed.
 
 
• **Example:** He is still on the fence about which college to attend.
 
 
 
• **Through thick and thin** (हर परिस्थिति में): To support someone in both good and bad times.
 
 
• **Example:** They have been together through thick and thin.
